title: Scheduled delivery confirmation

left.subject: Scheduled delivery confirmation
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Kian,

Your equipment delivery is scheduled for tomorrow.

Track or modify your delivery in the Logistics Portal.

We will not request payments for internal deliveries.

right.subject: Package held — address mismatch
right.bodyHtml:
Your package is on hold due to an address conflict.

Please validate your address and pay a small release fee.

Processing must be completed within 2 hours.

explainPoints: Domain distortion: Email B uses "nxtrust-logistics.com" which is visually similar but incorrect. Email A uses the real "nexatrust.com" domain.
Short deadline pressure: Email B demands completion within "2 hours" forcing urgency, a classic phishing tactic. Email A provides normal scheduling info.
Unexpected payment request: Email B requests a release fee. Email A explicitly states "We will not request payments for internal deliveries."
